result.topic_en: Formula notes on the functional equation of the zeta function in terms of Π (Gauss's factorial function), a decomposition of log ξ(t), and sketches of integration contours with horizontal lines at heights πni in the complex plane.
result.transcription:
$\Pi(\frac{s}{2})(s-1)\pi^{-\frac{s}{2}}\zeta(s)$
$=\Pi(\frac{1-s}{2})(-s)\pi^{-\frac{1-s}{2}}\zeta(1-s)$
$\Pi(\frac{s}{2}+\frac{1}{4})(s-\frac{1}{2})\pi^{-\frac{s}{2}}\zeta(s+\frac{1}{2})$
$\partial\log\xi(t)\, e^{4\sigma\sigma}[?]=-i$
$\log\xi(t)=-\frac{s}{2}\log\pi+\log(s-\frac{1}{2})+\log\Pi(\frac{s}{2}+\frac{1}{4})+\log\zeta(s+\frac{1}{2})$

methods.what: Functional equation of the Riemann zeta function written with the Gauss Π function, including factors (s-1) and (-s)
Shifted (symmetric) form of the completed zeta function, argument shifted by 1/2
Logarithm of ξ decomposed into the sum of logarithms of its factors
Sketches of integration contours with horizontal lines at heights πni and π(n+1)i, with direction arrows
